params.body:
`lib/policy.test.mjs` failed on main ("r.json is not a function"). Since #42 the laptop hands a signed policy version to `ingest/policy-version` without a Portal token, since the signature is the proof, and reads the answer with `r.json()`. The test still faked the old token route (`control/policy`, `Authorization: Bearer`) and gave the response only a `text()`.

The test now fakes `policy-version` and a response with `ok` and `json()`, and asserts that the draft is read with the token while the version is sent without one. A stale duplicate docblock above `keepPolicyVersion` is removed.

`node --test --experimental-test-module-mocks` (the flag `mcp/package.json` runs with): 78 passed, 0 failed.
params.title: policy.test: the signed version goes to policy-version without a token
